factual_claims.source_evidence: Statement of Cash Flow (GROUP) shows cash and cash equivalents on 30 September 2025 of EUR 54,398 million vs EUR 17,203 million on 31 December 2024.

factual_claims.claim: Total equity rose to EUR 167.721 million after EUR 13.158 million of profit, partly offset by EUR 8.622 million in dividends.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Statement of Changes in Equity (GROUP) shows total equity of EUR 167,721 million as at 30 September 2025. The movement includes net profit of EUR 13,158 million and dividends declared of EUR 8,622 million.

factual_claims.claim: No significant subsequent events were reported.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Note 19 states: 'No other significant events have occurred after the date of financial statements that would require disclosure or amendment in the financial statements.'

numerical_claims.claim: AB KN Energies reported consolidated revenue of EUR 76.664 million for the nine months ended 30 September 2025, up 12.8% from EUR 67.977 million in the same period of 2024.
numerical_claims.label: CORRECT
numerical_claims.source_evidence: Statement of Comprehensive Income (GROUP) shows revenue of EUR 76,664 thousand for 1-9 months 2025 and EUR 67,977 thousand for 1-9 months 2024. The percentage increase calculation matches 12.8%.

numerical_claims.claim: Gross profit increased 7.9% to EUR 31.549 million, with gross margin narrowing from approximately 43.0% to 41.1% as cost of sales rose 16.5% to EUR 45.115 million.
numerical_claims.label: CORRECT
numerical_claims.source_evidence: Statement of Comprehensive Income (GROUP) provides all figures: gross profit EUR 31,549 thousand (2025) vs EUR 29,237 thousand (2024); revenue EUR 76,664 thousand (2025) vs EUR 67,977 thousand (2024); cost of sales EUR 45,115 thousand (2025) vs EUR 38,740 thousand (2024). All percentages and values match.

numerical_claims.claim: Operating profit grew 12.4% to EUR 21.282 million despite distribution and administrative expenses increasing 2.1% to EUR 10.640 million.
numerical_claims.label: CORRECT
numerical_claims.source_value: 21,282 (2025) vs 18,942 (2024) = 12.4% increase; operating expenses EUR 10,640 thousand (2025) vs EUR 10,419 thousand (2024) = 2.1% increase
numerical_claims.source_evidence: Statement of Comprehensive Income (GROUP) shows operating profit of EUR 21,282 thousand for 2025 and EUR 18,942 thousand for 2024. Note 15 shows distribution and administrative expenses of EUR 10,640 thousand for 2025 and EUR 10,419 thousand for 2024.

numerical_claims.claim: Profit before tax rose 8.6% to EUR 16.186 million, while net profit increased 10.9% to EUR 13.158 million.
numerical_claims.label: CORRECT
numerical_claims.source_value: 16,186 (2025 PBT) vs 14,910 (2024 PBT) = 8.6% increase; 13,158 (2025 net profit) vs 11,862 (2024 net profit) = 10.9% increase
numerical_claims.source_evidence: Statement of Comprehensive Income (GROUP) provides profit before tax of EUR 16,186 thousand for 2025 and EUR 14,910 thousand for 2024. Net profit is EUR 13,158 thousand for 2025 and EUR 11,862 thousand for 2024.

numerical_claims.claim: Earnings per share improved from EUR 0.031 to EUR 0.035.
numerical_claims.label: CORRECT
numerical_claims.source_evidence: Note 17 shows basic and diluted earnings per share of EUR 0.035 for 2025 and EUR 0.031 for 2024.

numerical_claims.claim: Total comprehensive income reached EUR 13.215 million, compared with EUR 11.615 million in 2024.
numerical_claims.label: CORRECT
numerical_claims.source_evidence: Statement of Comprehensive Income (GROUP) shows total comprehensive income of EUR 13,215 thousand for 2025 and EUR 11,615 thousand for 2024.

numerical_claims.claim: The company’s separate net profit increased 8.5%, from EUR 10.702 million to EUR 11.613 million.
numerical_claims.label: CORRECT
numerical_claims.source_evidence: Statement of Comprehensive Income (COMPANY) shows profit for the year of EUR 11,613 thousand for 2025 and EUR 10,702 thousand for 2024.

numerical_claims.claim: LNG regasification and reloading revenue increased to EUR 43.640 million from EUR 31.401 million.
numerical_claims.label: CORRECT
numerical_claims.source_evidence: Note 13 specifies income from LNGT regasification services collected directly from users as EUR 43,640 thousand for 2025 and EUR 31,401 thousand for 2024.

numerical_claims.claim: Liquid energy transshipment revenue increased to EUR 21.375 million from EUR 20.241 million, while consulting revenue rose to EUR 7.507 million from EUR 3.961 million.
numerical_claims.label: CORRECT
numerical_claims.source_value: 21,375 (2025 transshipment) vs 20,241 (2024 transshipment); 7,507 (2025 consulting) vs 3,961 (2024 consulting)
numerical_claims.source_evidence: Note 13 breaks down revenue: sales of liquid energy products transshipment services were EUR 21,375 thousand for 2025 and EUR 20,241 thousand for 2024; sales of consulting services were EUR 7,507 thousand for 2025 and EUR 3,961 thousand for 2024.

numerical_claims.claim: A EUR 2.753 million reduction in LNG security supplement income related to repayment of excess regulated returns from 2022–2023 was reported.
numerical_claims.label: CORRECT
numerical_claims.source_evidence: Note 13(3) states: 'The decrease in revenue was affected by the reduction of LNG security supplement income in 2025 due to proportionally recognised repayment of the excess returns (surplus income) from regulated activities during the period 2022-2023.' The amount is EUR 2,753 thousand.

numerical_claims.claim: Depreciation and amortisation included EUR 11.369 million of FSRU depreciation in 2025.
numerical_claims.label: CORRECT
numerical_claims.source_evidence: Note 14 states: 'Following the acquisition of the FSRU on 6 December 2024, the asset was reclassified... Accordingly, during the nine months of 2025, EUR 11,369 thousand of depreciation expenses related to the FSRU were included in the cost of sales.'

numerical_claims.claim: FSRU operation and maintenance costs increased to EUR 6.602 million from EUR 5.698 million, while environmental taxes and emission allowance costs rose to EUR 3.892 million from EUR 2.009 million.
numerical_claims.label: CORRECT
numerical_claims.source_evidence: Note 14 provides these figures directly under the cost of sales breakdown.

numerical_claims.label: CORRECT
numerical_claims.source_evidence: Statement of Cash Flow (GROUP) shows net cash flows from operating activities of EUR 76,331 thousand for 2025 and EUR 35,637 thousand for 2024.

numerical_claims.label: CORRECT
